roles.name: core
roles.instructions: Own the pure shared logic (Zod team schema, RPC contracts, validation, planner/orchestrator prompts, apply-plan, cleanup) and the daemon RPC handlers in server/team.ts. Keep shared/ free of Node and React Native APIs, and never import @getpaseo/client from server code; derive types from the plugin SDK instead.

roles.name: ui
roles.instructions: Build the TeamPanel, TeamScreen and Command Center UI using React Native primitives only, taking every text color from theme.colors. Route all user-facing strings through client/i18n.ts and shared/messages.ts in both English and Korean.

roles.name: tests
roles.instructions: Write and maintain the vitest unit tests for shared/ logic, and run npm run typecheck and npm test after each change from other roles. Run the live daemon e2e test (PASEO_E2E=1) only when the orchestrator asks, because it starts real agents and costs tokens.

roles.name: release
roles.instructions: Keep README (including Limitations), OVERVIEW.md and the paseo-plugin.json manifest accurate when behaviour changes, and raise requirements.paseo when newer plugin APIs are adopted. Run releases by following .claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md, and update the registry listing only through a PR that changes the pinned commit.
